name: MK-677 for looks

card.summary: Use of the oral growth hormone secretagogue MK-677 (ibutamoren) by lifters seeking more lean mass, better sleep and recovery for a more muscular physique.
card.note: Investigational drug not approved for human consumption in the US; banned in most sports.

quick.overview:
MK-677, also called ibutamoren, is an experimental oral drug that mimics ghrelin and raises growth hormone and IGF-1. People in lifting and bodybuilding communities discuss it for lean mass, sleep and recovery, which they connect to a more muscular, fuller physique.

Human research has examined its effects on growth hormone, lean body mass, sleep and bone density, mostly in older adults and in growth hormone deficiency. It has not been approved for marketing.
quick.how: Users on T Nation describe taking it orally, often at night, and checking IGF-1 with bloodwork. Some pair it with other secretagogues or with testosterone therapy. Reported effects include sleep changes and weight gain.
quick.risks: It is an investigational drug not approved for human consumption in the US and is banned in most sports. It raises cortisol along with growth hormone and IGF-1 per Wikipedia. Anyone considering it would need medical guidance.

lead: MK-677 for looks refers to the use of ibutamoren, an investigational oral ghrelin-receptor agonist, to pursue a more muscular physique. It is also known as LUM-201 and L-163,191 [1].

The drug mimics ghrelin and raises growth hormone and IGF-1 levels and keeps them elevated, and it also raises cortisol [1]. Lifters connect this to increased lean mass, better sleep and recovery, which they associate with more training and a bigger physique. On T Nation, users post IGF-1 results and sleep observations [2][4].
Clinical research includes studies in older adults and in children with growth hormone deficiency [1].

chain: Oral secretagogue raises growth hormone and IGF-1
Lean mass gain and deeper sleep reported in studies and by users
Recovery supports training and a fuller physique
angle.text: Users hope that higher GH and IGF-1 add lean mass and improve recovery. One T Nation user wrote that it seems to affect his sleep positively.

infobox: Investigational; not approved for human consumption in US

paras: Wikipedia describes ibutamoren as a potent, long-acting, orally active, selective non-peptide agonist of the ghrelin receptor [1]. A single dose kept IGF-1 elevated in humans for up to 24 hours [1].

sections.h: Use in looksmaxxing and lifting communities
paras: On T Nation, a strongman log mentioned that MK-677 appeared to affect sleep positively [2]. Another thread documented a user's repeated IGF-1 measurements around adding MK-677 [4], and others discussed it as a lower-cost option alongside testosterone therapy [5] or compared its IGF-1 effect with other secretagogues [6]. Wikipedia notes that some in the bodybuilding community have used it experimentally [1].

According to Wikipedia, human studies reported increased GH secretion and lean body mass without change in total or visceral fat, and increases in muscle mass and bone mineral density, which motivated study in frailty [1]. In a study of 14 subjects taking a bedtime dose, REM sleep rose about 20 percent in young and 50 percent in older subjects [1]. In children with growth hormone deficiency, phase 2 trials reportedly met their endpoints [1].
It is an investigational new drug, not approved for marketing for human consumption in the United States, and is banned in most sports [1].

claims.believers: A strongman log reports that it seems to impact sleep positively [2].
claims.experts: A small study cited by Wikipedia found increased REM and slow-wave sleep [1].

claims.claim: MK-677 raises IGF-1 into a healthy range
claims.believers: Users post lab values tracking IGF-1 after adding it [4].
claims.experts: Studies report it keeps IGF-1 elevated [1].
